content.text: {"groups":[{"card_ids":["C01","C02"],"headline":"OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol; Copilot rollout remains gradual","supported_fact":"OpenAI pitches stronger agentic coding at lower cost than Astra, with benchmark comparisons remaining vendor-reported; GitHub confirms a gradual Copilot rollout."},{"card_ids":["C03","C04"],"headline":"Pi adds MCP support alongside JavaScript tool orchestration","supported_fact":"Earendil explains Pi’s MCP support and JavaScript-based tool orchestration; the post does not establish adoption or reliability gains."},{"card_ids":["C05","C06"],"headline":"Opus 5.5 benchmark is collecting a baseline, without a verdict","supported_fact":"The benchmark maintainers are collecting an Opus 5.5 baseline and have not reached a performance-regression verdict."},{"card_ids":["C07","C08"],"headline":"OpenAI documents gradually rolling out cross-device Codex cloud tasks","supported_fact":"OpenAI documents prepared, reusable cloud environments for coding tasks across devices; access is rolling out gradually."},{"card_ids":["C09","C10"],"headline":"Anthropic evaluation reports open-weight model exploit development","supported_fact":"Anthropic’s evaluation reports end-to-end exploit development by an open-weight model; the findings remain attributed to the evaluating lab and are not independently reproduced here."},{"card_ids":["C11","C12"],"headline":"OpenAI announces cloud agents for work across connected apps","supported_fact":"OpenAI announces cloud computers and agents for work across connected apps, with a staged rollout."},{"card_ids":["C13"],"headline":"Hypothetical: OpenAI changes GPT-6.1 Sol API pricing after launch","supported_fact":"The fixture describes a hypothetical pricing change a month after launch."},{"card_ids":["C14"],"headline":"Hypothetical: Pi patches an MCP connector security bug","supported_fact":"The fixture describes a hypothetical security patch two months after MCP support launched."}] }]} boot
